DS-01 · Design

Graphics and UI/UX design

Interfaces, graphics, templates, icons and reusable visual systems.

Discuss your project

Good software still fails if people cannot use it. KT INDIA designs interfaces and the visual systems around them: graphics, professional documents, templates, icons and brand assets.

Because design sits in the same team as engineering, interfaces are designed to be built, and built the way they were designed.

A good fit when

  • Your product works but is hard to use.
  • You need a consistent look across documents and screens.
  • You are starting a product and want the interface right first.

What this covers

  • UI/UX design
  • Graphics
  • Professional documents and templates
  • Icons
  • Brand assets
  • Design systems

Every project is scoped to the requirement. [Client to confirm typical deliverables, e.g. documentation, source code handover, support period.]

Process

How the work runs

  1. 01

    Discover / Research

    Define the real problem, the users and the constraints before choosing a technology.

  2. 02

    Engineer / Build

    Design and build across software, electronics and AI, using whichever combination fits.

  3. 03

    Validate / Evidence

    Test against the requirement with data, not assumptions. Evidence before assumption.

  4. 04

    Deliver / Impact

    Ship a working system, document it and support it as it is used.
